problem: Stale queued Actions and duplicate website PR workflows continued consuming runner capacity after the first single-flight consolidation.
root_cause: Stale Actions cleanup depended on the full hourly repository janitor and heavy V18/canonical-shell verification still existed as independent pull_request entrypoints although lane-website already covered exact build, preview, SEO and browser verification.
prevention: Run identity-safe stale Actions drainage independently every ten minutes and after changes to its own control plane land on main.
Never cancel main, the exact current head of an open PR, Obligation Terminal Closure, or merged-branch cleanup.
Require exact obsolete identity before cancellation and use a longer grace period for in-progress work.
Make lane-website the automatic PR owner for heavy V18/canonical-shell build, preview and browser verification.
Keep canonical live shell readback main-only and legacy full build/V18 promotion explicit diagnostics or recovery.
